brief:
Rapper Macklemore is standing by his "Free Palestine" statement made while opening for Ed Sheeran, despite criticism from pro-Israel organizations, Al Jazeera English reported. The artist's remarks during the concert prompted backlash from groups opposed to the statement, challenging his public position on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

Macklemore defended his stance in response to the controversy, maintaining his right to speak on the issue. The incident underscores the polarized reactions that public figures often encounter when addressing the conflict, with supporters and critics mobilizing around statements on Palestinian rights and Israel's policies.
dek: Macklemore is facing backlash from pro-Israel groups after saying ‘Free Palestine’ while opening for Ed Sheeran.
title: Macklemore defends Palestine remarks after Israel groups' backlash
